title: Technoprobe
summary: Italian maker of advanced probe cards for semiconductor test.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Technoprobe designs and builds probe cards for wafer-level and final test, with a focus on high-pin-count, fine-pitch applications such as processors and advanced packaging. It has been expanding into MEMS probes and testing for chiplets. Customer concentration among large chipmakers is significant.

Technology Exposure

  • Probe cards for wafer test
  • MEMS probe technology
  • Advanced packaging test

What To Watch

  • Leading-edge chip test demand
  • Customer concentration
  • Capacity expansion

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
